meta.description: Peirce wrote this formulation in How to Make Our Ideas Clear, published in Popular Science Monthly in January 1878. It is the pragmatic maxim.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Peirce proposes testing the meaning of a conception through the practical effects one could conceive it having. The passage is an account of intellectual clarity, rather than a simple instruction to favor whatever happens to be useful.
